baseline: H0: res60s1 with causal EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: prior-only split-safe 250-observation new-high Long and new-low Short breakout

trials.description: One shallow LightGBM regressor using high/low breakout ranks, res60s1 and split-safe relative volume change

feature_definitions.res60s1: Prior 60 observed residual-return rows per listing segment, excluding signal day; centered cross-sectional rank.
feature_definitions.new_high_rank: Centered cross-sectional rank of max(split-safe Close_t / prior 250-observation split-safe High - 1, 0); rolling barrier excludes signal-day High and requires 250 observations.
feature_definitions.new_low_rank: Centered cross-sectional rank of max(prior 250-observation split-safe Low / split-safe Close_t - 1, 0); rolling barrier excludes signal-day Low and requires 250 observations.
feature_definitions.relative_volume_change_rank: log(split-safe raw Volume_t / median of the prior 20 split-safe raw Volume observations); centered cross-sectional rank; current-day Volume is available at signal close, prior median excludes current day.
feature_definitions.split_safe_volume: Raw Volume multiplied by cumulative AdjustmentFactor events within the listing segment; no AdjustmentVolume levels.
feature_definitions.missing_values: Keep unavailable 250-observation breakout and 20-observation volume history as NaN for native LightGBM missing-value routing; no backward fill.

model: LightGBM LGBMRegressor on the official Train target Return; annual expanding-window refit, no hyperparameter search.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive comparison only. No candidate adoption or reselection from known data.
selection_rule.diagnostic_stability: Report fold deltas; at least 3/4 improved folds would be needed for further consideration, not sufficient for adoption.
